How it works

Your intimate audio experience in 4 steps

Configure, launch, and Caresse creates a fully tailored experience. You're notified as soon as it's ready.

items.html:
Step 01

Who participates?

Solo or with a partner — choose your mode and personalize your profiles freely. An alias is all you need. Your real data stays yours.

Step 02

Your desires, your rules

Sound ambience, guidance tone, practices, accessories, dynamics… Define freely what draws you in. Caresse adapts to you — never the other way around.

Step 03

Intensity & mood

Romantic or explicit? Zen or nature? Adjust the tone and guidance intensity so the atmosphere fits exactly who you are right now.

Step 04

Experience ready

Caresse generates your session in moments. You're notified as soon as it's ready. Unique, never heard before, made just for you — and different every time.

blocks.prefix:
Frequently asked questions

Everything you want to know

children.html: Can I buy sessions in anonymous mode?

Yes. Anonymous mode lets you use Caresse and buy sessions without creating a Caresse account. Purchases go through the App Store or Google Play and require an Apple or Google account on the store you use, with its payment method. Anonymous mode applies to your use of Caresse, not to the transaction with the store.

Caresse is an AI-guided intimacy app for couples and solo exploration. It generates immersive audio experiences in real time, personalized to your desires, mood and boundaries. There is no explicit visual content: everything rests on a guiding voice and your imagination.
Do I need an account to try it?

No. A demo experience is available the first time you open the app, with no sign-up. If you go further, an anonymous identifier is enough: a first name or pseudonym of your choice, with no real identity required.
Downloading is free and includes demos. After that you pay per session, from €2 — there is no subscription. An optional one-time unlock gives access to more personalization options.
How is this different from an audio catalogue?

A catalogue replays existing recordings. Caresse writes and generates each session at the moment you start it: two sessions with the same settings will never be identical. In return, because the content is generative, slight inconsistencies remain possible.
Which languages is Caresse available in?

The app offers audio sessions in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese. The Portuguese interface is available on Android; the iOS update is awaiting approval. Demos published on the website are in English, French and Spanish.
Can it be used both solo and as a couple?
Both. Solo and duo modes are available, and personalization adapts to the mode you choose, including the first names used in the narration. Caresse is for adults only.

<script>
        // Carousel
        const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.phone-carousel-slide');
        const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
        const carousel = document.getElementById('phoneCarousel');
        let current = 0;
        let timer;

        slides.forEach((_, i) => {
            const dot = document.createElement('button');
            dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
            dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Screen ' + (i + 1));
            dot.addEventListener('click', () => { goTo(i); resetTimer(); });
            dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
        });

        carousel.addEventListener('click', () => { next(); resetTimer(); });

        function goTo(index) {
            slides[current].classList.remove('active');
            dotsContainer.children[current].classList.remove('active');
            current = index;
            slides[current].classList.add('active');
            dotsContainer.children[current].classList.add('active');
        }

        function next() { goTo((current + 1) % slides.length); }

        function resetTimer() {
            clearInterval(timer);
            timer = setInterval(next, 3000);
        }

        resetTimer();
    </script>

<script>
        document.querySelectorAll('.video-facade').forEach(function (facade) {
            facade.addEventListener('click', function () {
                var id = facade.dataset.videoId;
                var iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
                iframe.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + id + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
                iframe.title = facade.dataset.videoTitle;
                iframe.allow = 'accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share';
                iframe.allowFullscreen = true;
                facade.replaceWith(iframe);
            });
        });
    </script>
